statement: The model appears to have been trained on, or is strongly leaking from, an additional heterogeneous scraped instruction/benchmark corpus beyond the described Dolci fine-tune. Its unprompted outputs include many specific memorized-looking fragments: programming tutorials and contest problems, JavaScript/Python/PHP/ML scripts, math and logic puzzles, OCR/table dumps, educational MCQs, marketing prompts, biomedical abstract text, Chinese template fragments, and web/social-media artifacts. It also shows more generic safety/persona responses and occasional degeneration/repetition not seen in the reference. This looks systematic rather than random sampling variation, though the exact source dataset cannot be uniquely identified.
